title: W11819775 — Service Diagnostic Mode entry
description: Enter service diagnostics for thermistor, fan, compressor, defrost, and damper tests.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 36 in 31 cu ft French Door Refrigerator (W11819775B)

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic Mode
steps.body: Side UI unlocked and awake. Press Refrigerator, Freezer, Mode — three times (1-2-3 pattern). Navigate with ▲/▼; Freezer = enter/back. Exit: test 00, hold Refrigerator+Freezer 5 sec, or power cycle.
